Init installs passive/constellation hooks (xilonen.go:49-75); A1 modifies later Normal/Plunge damage and points, C4 modifies later Normal/Extra/Plunge hits, and C6 applies later attack modifiers/heals (asc.go:22-89; cons.go:131-260). scopeNotes: Capture `xilonen.skill.blessing-at-entry` from the one original HasBlessing() result; false=>1 root, true=>0. Observe through frame 6 for hit branch, then native terminal dispatch; zero branch closes with no attack dispatch.

The talisman callback applies a 15s enemy status only if that zero-damage attack hits an enemy (Classic burst.go:53-60; Stellar burst.go:27-43). Stellar has an additional direct Q attack only in the original revelation/Stellar Conduct condition and calls c6OnBurst, which changes status/energy/heal behavior; source lane diff is semantically material and represented by branch fact `qiqi.burst.stellar-conduct-at-entry`. Init subscriptions heal on later enemy damage and process later Qiqi NA/CA hooks; they do not create another Q attack (qiqi.go:40-48; Classic burst.go:73-120; Stellar burst.go:77 onward). A1/C1/C2 are heal, energy, or later NA/CA modifier hooks (asc.go:15-45; cons.go:13-53); Stellar C4 adds healing when talisman healing occurs; C6-on-Burst sets status/stacks for later hit modifiers (cons.go:238-252), not a new Q root. Never claim talisman was applied unless the zero-damage callback actually dispatched to an enemy.
scopeNotes: Two unconditional deliveries in both lanes: zero-damage talisman application at frame 40 and Cryo Q hit at frame 82. Stellar third direct root at 82 only when `qiqi.burst.stellar-conduct-at-entry` is 1. Close only after all observed roots finish native dispatch; talisman status application is target-hit-dependent.

rows.label: 埃洛伊 E

Missing `bomblets` defaults to 2; zero/negative values add no roots. `travel` defaults 5 and `bomb_delay` defaults 0; both affect timing only (skill.go:45-58,72-104). Main particle callback is particle-only (116-128); bomblet coil callback advances stack/state and adds A1/A4 modifiers on reaching four stacks but queues no attack (131-183; asc.go:11-67). Init sets up those modifiers/listeners; no E child attack (aloy.go:41-55). Stellar only reorders action frame defaults for Dash/Swap; root algorithm unchanged.

rows.label: 妮露 Q：初击与逐目标完整第二段

第二段保留敌人自己的局部时钟：原 121 local frames 后任务执行时重读生命值/天赋，立刻向该父回调目标发出一次单体攻击；停帧不会被误换算为全局 +121。
完整范围包含本次初击及其所有实际敌人回调任务；初击落空、跳过或命中确认阻断不会产生任务。目标死亡后敌人队列不 tick，未执行任务继续 pending，不能宣告完整。
不伪造 Origin；原生 callback→producer→taskId→enemy queue targetKey 的明确链接建立所有权，entry Origin 仅用于隔离同步嵌套反应/独立追击。
lingeringaeon 状态只在原命中处添加；延迟任务未检查状态或新 Q，因此重叠 Q 不取消旧任务，全部按真实父回调独立追踪。
同击支持的增幅/加算反应仍进入该击；独立反应、丰穰之核、装备或其他事件追击保留独立范围。固定源码证据不是实机机制验证。

rows.label: 欧洛伦 E
rows.sourceEvidence: skill.go:26-75 builds the existing enemy slice with primary target plus up to `3+c1ExtraBounce()` (lines 47-55), then the loop at 60-69 queues exactly one direct attack for each selected target. Proposed capture writes the already-computed `len(enemies)` at line 56 before the loop; there is no extra enemy/count query. Each outgoing target hit has its own damage deadline `31 + travel*(i+1)`.
rows.nonDamageCallbacksAndInitAudit: Native E loops over its already-selected targets and queues one Spirit Orb root per target. particleCB only creates particles; makeA4cb installs energy-restoration status; makeC1cb installs target Hypersense bonus status. Init A1 listens to ElectroCharged, LunarCharged and other actors' Nightsoul damage; these can produce independent Hypersense attacks, including reactions caused by E, and remain outside this intrinsic Spirit Orb scope. E grants a status for later allied Hydro/Electro hits to generate Nightsoul points. A4 listens to later Normal/Extra/Plunge for energy. C1 extends selection by two and modifies Hypersense; C2 modifies stats; C6's direct Hypersense belongs to Burst. See asc.go:36-164,169-215 and cons.go:19-77.
scopeNotes: Root count equals the recorded length of the exact native selected-target slice. The original code inserts its primary target and then adds enemies up to 3 + C1 extra bounces; do not replace this observation with an inferred enemy count.
Each root snapshots at frame 31; damage dispatch is scheduled at 31 + travel × (i+1), where omitted travel is 10. Preserve the source parameter.
Independent A1 Hypersense, reaction damage and later-action effects are excluded from this Spirit Orb damage scope; closure does not claim those effects cannot occur.

rows.label: 莱依拉 E：护盾归属与完整星矢
rows.sourceEvidence: 与 shield.go 原递归／事件／回调全路径共同审阅；详见 docs/validation/source-layla-ownership-audit-20260930.json 与双来源原文件哈希。
rows.nonDamageCallbacksAndInitAudit: Init安装starsSkill/A1及C4/C6；C4只给其他普攻/重击同击加FlatDmg并延迟删状态；C6只增伤和改变积星间隔；shootStars的C2回调只回能、共享particleCB只产球与粒子ICD，不另发伤害。
scopeNotes: 完整 E 包含本次初击与本次实际创建护盾的晚星／星矢；技能事件或 Q 命中仅贡献晚星，产生的星矢始终归对应护盾出生调用。
重复 E 若找到旧盾，仅改同对象 Expires，不创建新盾或补满护盾量。该 E 的初击仍归自身，旧盾及后续星矢继续归旧出生调用；刷新前后有效期与实际任务均保留。
自然积星使用角色局部时钟90帧（C6为72）；发射使用核心任务6帧寻敌轮询、30帧锁定等待、27帧逐星间隔，以及35/33/30/28帧实际飞行。
护盾到期／破裂只在未射击时清掉晚星；已启动 shoot 链并不检查护盾存在，可以跨护盾终点完成。无敌人时可一直等待；必须等所有已登记任务及在途攻击结束，不能按护盾结束直接关闭。
最后一星重新读取原生护盾门；若已经有后来出生的盾，新自然积星任务绑定该实际对象，旧星矢不迁移归属。
每击继续使用既有伤害核心与完整上下文；C2仅回能、粒子回调仅产球，C4改其他动作同击附加，A1/C6为已有修饰器，不额外冒充独立 E 攻击。固定来源证据不是实机验证。

rows.sourceEvidence: 与 shield.go 原递归／事件／回调全路径共同审阅；详见 docs/validation/source-layla-ownership-audit-20260930.json 与双来源原文件哈希。

scopeNotes: Q 保留8个原生核心调度任务（36+90i），每个任务按实际目标选择排0或1枚 Starlight Slug；不把8次调度写死为8次伤害。

rows.label: 雷电将军 E 初击与各持有者状态拥有的恶曜之眼协同攻击
rows.sourceEvidence: Verified pinned raw skill.go:36-52 queues one initial hit at +51f; 55-73 creates one +66f task per actual party character and installs that holder's raiden-e AttackMod with 1500f hitlag-extendable lifetime. Init-installed OnEnemyDamage listener (raiden.go:43-44; skill.go:108-156) gates on the triggering attack actor's live modifier and the caster's shared 54f eyeICD, then queues one Eye strike with QueueAttack(5,5). Each successful event is bound to the holder's exact modifier instance, activation producer and current invocation, retaining its original event ancestry.
rows.nonDamageCallbacksAndInitAudit: The raiden-e AttackMod Amount returns only for Burst-tagged attacks and reads the holder EnergyMax using the caster's captured skillBurstBonus multiplier; its buff value is not intrinsic E damage. Particle chance/ICD/callback and energy queue do not emit damage. Recast does not reset shared eyeICD. Native modifier expiry deletion is recorded when ApplyAttackMods removes the object; no synthetic expiry task is added. StatusIsActive accepts the exact expiry frame, ApplyAttackMods removes expiry<=frame, and hitlag may extend finalExpiry. An already queued Eye strike is not cancelled or reassigned by expiry or recast.
